rv.q: Powered by a quartet of stellar performances, it’s everything you love about musical theater dialed up to an 11.
Lush visuals, interesting music, a witty script and a timeless theme explored by talent that’s to die for.
“Death Becomes Her” is an entirely sassy, high-energy and go-for-broke take on the 1992 black comedy fantasy movie.

cn.t: Critics praise this raucously entertaining Broadway hit as a laugh riot powered by stellar comic performances, particularly from its female leads, plus lavish production values and zingy one-liners that dial musical theater spectacle up to eleven.
